name: Linkedin Poster
description: Drafts and publishes high-quality LinkedIn posts that sound like the user, not like an AI summary. Reads a reusable per-user profile (interests, audience, voice samples, archetypes, forbidden phrases) and runs a per-post loop: pick an archetype (news reaction, lesson, milestone, provocative question, story), source content, draft 2-3 variants, surface for explicit approval, publish. In Cowork it can auto-fetch voice samples from a LinkedIn profile URL, surface drafts in Dispatch for approval, and auto-type the approved post into LinkedIn at 35-68 WPM. In Claude.ai or the API it works from manually pasted samples and hands the user a copy/paste-ready draft. Anti-mimic guardrail when modeling another writer's style; never clicks Post (the human stays the publisher).
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, `linkedin-poster` (Drafts and publishes high-quality LinkedIn posts that sound like the user, not like an AI summary).

Installs with `claude plugin install linkedin-poster@claude-community` from `cnfcnf/linkedin-poster`.

A Claude skill for drafting and publishing LinkedIn posts that sound like the person posting them — not like an AI summary.
